title: The glass is sturdy and they look very nice filled with my treats
text:
The glass is sturdy and they look very nice filled with my treats. I purchased these to store my sugar free treats in as they have gaskets to keep the air out. They have a plastic/vinyl chalk board looking label on each it came with a "chalk" stick too. The glass is sturdy and they look very nice filled with my treats. The measurements given in the listing are accurate. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seems useful.
UPDATE 3/21/2017.... I opened one box and set one box aside, just opening yesterday. One of the jars is not sealing... it's lid is very loose. That's not ok. Further... it mentions "seasoning" the black plastic or vinyl like labels ("chalk board look") before using... I am not aware or familiar of how to do that and so did not. Seems to work fine.
